death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_: %1$s was engulfed and crushed by %2$s's clouds
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_rail.gu: Conjure a cascading line of magical clouds in front of you. These clouds fall freely from the sky, exploding and dealing area damage upon impact with the ground.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_ring.gu: Conjure multiple expanding rings of magical clouds centered on your position. These clouds descend from the sky in a rhythmic cascade, dealing heavy area damage upon impacting the ground.
